name: Dumbbell Incline Fly
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline and lie back with feet planted flat.
Hold two dumbbells above your upper chest with palms facing each other and elbows softly bent.
Open your arms out wide in an arc until you feel a comfortable stretch across your chest.
Sweep both dumbbells back together above your upper chest along the same arc.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades in contact with the pad as your arms open.
Maintain a fixed bend in your elbows so the move stays a fly rather than a press.
